about.heading: From network cabling to Kubernetes clusters
about.body: I started in IT infrastructure — structured cabling, Windows Server, Active Directory, VMware clusters — and grew into modern DevOps practice: CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and observability. That background means I don't just automate deployments, I understand the network, security, and systems layers underneath them. I currently work as a Senior System Administrator / Cloud Engineer while taking on DevOps and cloud-automation projects on Upwork.

bullets: Designed end-to-end CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, cutting deployment time by 80% and eliminating manual release errors
Containerized multi-service apps with Docker/Compose, deployed to Kubernetes (Minikube/k3s) with rolling updates
Provisioned AWS infrastructure (EC2, S3, VPC, IAM) with Terraform, cutting environment setup from days to under 30 minutes
Automated server configuration with Ansible — user setup, UFW firewall rules, package management
Built a Prometheus + Grafana observability stack with custom dashboards and CPU/memory/uptime alerting
Administered Active Directory (500+ users), VMware ESXi clusters, and SQL Server across a multi-site environment
Automated routine sysadmin tasks with PowerShell/Bash, saving ~15 hours/week
Maintained VMware ESXi/vSphere and Hyper-V clusters, improving server utilization by 30%
Implemented firewall rules and VPN configs with zero security breaches during tenure
Provided Tier 2/3 support for ERP and attendance systems, maintaining a 95% satisfaction rate
